title: PSG4-ELASTIC-THIRD-BANK: linear classical storage with an adaptive-base source reduction

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), L=log2n, the ONE physical PSG4-ELASTIC-THIRD-BANK interpreter in proof.md executes the entire scoped PSG4-ELASTIC-THIRD program in virtual.md with fixed selected q=1/2,alpha=3/8,kappa=3/4,lambda=7/4,rho=1. It uses exhaustive testing for n<256 and otherwise computes ell_base=ceil(log2n), g_base largest integer with g_base^8*ell_base^3<=n^4, u=min(R,max(1,floor(R/3)+floor(7g_base/4))), and the first exact C4096 delta profile with2S_u(R)>=n, recomputing all source/decoder/precision/acquisition/weighted-work caps. It recovers the entire secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional success at least1-2^-8>2/3. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed work, discarded copies, wrong labels, both aborts, bank growth, source moves and output-first cleanup, fully paid time T is O(2^((3/4)sqrt(nL)+sqrt(n)L^(-3/8))) with exact growth index1/2. All outside constants are absolute. The counted CQ simulation preserves virtual output and source-request laws; the internal G/4 time gap pays its full polynomial overhead. All padding, basis/coherent/source scratch, typed metadata, bit arithmetic, generated gates, addressing, reset and cleanup count jointly with both physical spaces, source cap, full-secret success and clean fraction0. Virtual memory columns are not substituted as physical bounds.

For the same PSG4-ELASTIC-THIRD-BANK algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
